units.source_text: 十二月十九日起，照例举办三天佛名会。

en.t: Beginning on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month, the three-day Buddha-name ceremony was held as usual.

units.source_text: 想是源氏已经确信这是此生最后一次了，听见僧人锡杖的声音，比往常更加感慨。

en.t: Genji must already have been certain that this would be the last such ceremony of his life, for the sound of the monks' ringed staffs moved him more deeply than usual.

units.source_text: 僧众向佛祈愿主人长寿，源氏听了但觉伤心，不知佛对他作何指示。

en.t: As the monks prayed to the Buddha for their master's long life, Genji listened with only sadness, not knowing what guidance the Buddha might give him.

units.source_text: 此时大雪纷飞，已经积得很厚。

en.t: At that time heavy snow was falling thickly, and it had already piled up deep.

units.source_text: 导师退出之时，源氏召他进来，敬酒一杯，礼仪比往常更为隆重，赏赐亦特别丰厚。

en.t: When the officiating priest was about to withdraw, Genji summoned him in and offered him a cup of wine, observing the rites more solemnly than usual and giving especially generous gifts.

units.source_text: 这位导师多年来经常出入六条院，又早就为朝廷服务，是源氏从小见惯的。

en.t: This priest had for many years often come and gone at Rokujo-in, and had long served the court as well; Genji had known him by sight since childhood.

units.source_text: 现已变成白头老僧，还在服务，源氏很可怜他。

en.t: Now he had become a white-haired old monk and was still serving, and Genji felt great pity for him.

units.source_text: 诸亲王及公卿，照例来六条院参与佛名会。

en.t: The various princes and court nobles came to Rokujo-in as usual to take part in the Buddha-name ceremony.

units.source_text: 此时梅花含苞待放，映着雪色，分外鲜妍可爱。

en.t: At this time the plum blossoms were in bud and ready to open, and against the color of the snow they looked especially fresh, vivid, and lovely.
Ordinarily there would have been a gathering for music with strings and winds.

units.source_text: 但今年源氏听到琴笛之声，觉得都有呜咽之感，故不用管弦，只是朗诵了一些适合时宜的诗歌。

en.t: But this year, whenever Genji heard the sounds of koto and flute, they all seemed to carry the feeling of sobbing, so he dispensed with the music and merely had a few poems suited to the occasion recited.

units.source_text: 呀，刚才忘记说了：源氏向导师敬酒时，奉赠一诗：

en.t: Ah, I forgot to mention it earlier: when Genji offered wine to the officiating priest, he presented him with this poem:
